[NLFC.9.2] **After the first stream event it is refused.** Once the engine
has emitted a stream event ([NLFC.9.1]), the engine must refuse a seed with
`DS_ERR_STATE` and leave the cache unchanged. The cache is thereafter mutated
only by rule `cache` / `cache_delete` writes ([LSTO.4.7.2]); restoring state
mid-run is not a supported operation. Like clone ([NLFC.8]), the seed mints no
new error codes.
